d8d9d5afaf4b: The simplified text tab · translationCore 4 Help
11d11f91dffc: It says the meaning plainly, which helps when the literal text is hard to follow.
69ca10aa2161: In Understand or Translate, open the helps panel.
cc56fdfc1c5a: Click UST. Some gateway languages name this tab differently, such as GST.
e57198b5a7a0: Words in curly braces, such as {write this letter to you, Titus. I}, are part of the simplified text. They mark words added to make the meaning clear.
0ed9bffcd127: You can also show the simplified text in the main source column with the UST source tab.
ce9523f1ef63: In Check, Translation Notes and Translation Words show the simplified text as a third source card, with the quote highlighted. See Check with Translation Notes.
8e322c521c99: Open Bible Stories have no simplified text, so there is no tab for it.
fa7803eb96ac: The UST tab in Understand, headed Simplified text · meaning-based, with the simplified text of Titus 1:1–3. Verse 1 starts I, Paul, {write this letter to you, Titus. I} am a servant of God.
